target_customer: Crypto users and web3 applications moving stablecoins across blockchains and layer 2 networks
problem: Moving stablecoins between chains relied on bridges that were slow, costly or insecure; Meson uses hash time locked contracts and pre-deposited liquidity to swap in minutes without a bridge.
business_model: Swap fees on stablecoin cross-chain transfers plus an SDK for other applications

founders.name: Edrick Guan
founders.background_notes: YC page bio: AWS and Alibaba Cloud certified cloud architect, product and people manager. No employers or school given.

founders.name: Zehao Li
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page; no bio.

founders.name: Xin Sun
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page; no bio.

technical_complexity.rationale: Atomic swaps with hash time locked contracts across many chains needed smart contract security work; the protocol was audited by Trail of Bits per the 2022 press release.

defensibility.rationale: The protocol design is documented publicly and no exclusive data or contracts are stated, so rivals in cross-chain transfer could copy the approach.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying or buying it.

market_need_then: Stablecoin cross-chain transfers had demand with the growth of layer 2 networks, but the sources date this to 2022, not the 2018 batch; evidence of demand at the batch date was not found.

branding.domain_note: Uses meson.fi, a .fi domain, not meson.com.

brand_strength.rationale: A brand search returned only the physics term and an unrelated build tool of the same name; no brand coverage of this company was found, though its name is shared with those and may be hard to search.

outcome_analysis: YC lists Meson as inactive, but its website was live with a working swap interface at the time of this research and no shutdown, acquisition or hack of Meson itself was found. A $4M round was announced in August 2022, four years after the Winter 2018 batch. The product described in every source is the 2022 stablecoin protocol, so the YC inactive flag may reflect a stale directory entry and the cause of any failure is not public.
notes: Status conflict: YC shows Inactive while meson.fi is live; exit left unknown. The Aug 2022 round stage is unstated in the press release; Dealroom calls it Series A and CB Insights and SeedTable call it seed, so stage is other. Some profile lists YC among investors (unverified). Founding year not found; HQ conflicts between Singapore (YC) and San Francisco (CB Insights). No competitor with a source dated near the 2018 batch was found, and the 2022 sources name none. Docs page fetch was blocked by a rate-limited safety check. Education and prior employers not found.
